template.name: WSO2 ESB Service Monitoring
template.description: Monitors a WSO2 ESB instance through its SOAP Admin API. Discovers deployed services via ServiceAdmin and collects per-service and system-wide request, response and fault counters from StatisticsAdmin.

item.name: WSO2 ESB: Port 9443 availability
item.description:
Checks whether the WSO2 management console port (9443) accepts connections. Issues an HTTP GET to https://{$WSO2.HOST}:9443/ and accepts any HTTP status (200-599). Returns: - 1 = port is reachable (HTTP header received) - 0 = port is unreachable (connection refused, timeout)
Check interval: 1 minute Timeout: 10 seconds

trigger.name: WSO2 platform is not accessible
trigger.description:
Port 9443 on {$WSO2.HOST} is not responding. All WSO2 ESB services are likely unreachable.
Status: {ITEM.LASTVALUE} Host: {HOST.NAME} URL: https://{$WSO2.HOST}:9443/
Suggested checks: 1. Verify the WSO2 server process is running 2. Verify firewall and network rules 3. Inspect wso2carbon.log for startup or runtime errors 4. Test manually: curl -k https://{$WSO2.HOST}:9443/
The trigger recovers automatically once port 9443 becomes reachable again.

item.name: WSO2 ESB: Total Service Count
item.description: Total number of services discovered on the ESB.

trigger.expression: last(/WSO2 ESB Service Monitoring/wso2.esb.services.count)>last(/WSO2 ESB Service Monitoring/wso2.esb.services.count,#2)
trigger.name: WSO2 ESB: New service(s) added

trigger.expression: last(/WSO2 ESB Service Monitoring/wso2.esb.services.count)<last(/WSO2 ESB Service Monitoring/wso2.esb.services.count,#2)
trigger.name: WSO2 ESB: Service(s) removed

item.name: WSO2 ESB: Services Delta (Added/Removed)
item.description: Difference between the current and previous service list. Returns JSON listing added and removed services.

item.name: WSO2 ESB: Service Discovery JSON
item.description: Service discovery via SOAP. Iterates through every page returned by listServices and outputs JSON containing service name, type and WSDL URL.

item.name: WSO2 ESB: Inactive Services List
item.description: Comma-separated list of services where active=false. Returns "All services active" when none are inactive.

trigger.name: WSO2 ESB: Inactive services detected ({ITEM.LASTVALUE})

item.name: WSO2 ESB: Service List Sorted
item.description: Sorted, comma-separated list of discovered service names.

item.name: WSO2 ESB: Delta Metrics JSON
item.description: Master item that performs a single SOAP call to StatisticsAdmin and returns JSON with totalRequestCount, totalFaultCount, totalResponseCount and timestamp. Dependent items derive deltas by comparing the current value to the previous one.

item.name: WSO2 ESB: Error Rate %
item.description: Total error rate: (totalFaultCount / totalRequestCount) * 100. Computed from the cumulative system counters. The 0.001 in the denominator avoids division by zero on a fresh server.

trigger.name: WSO2 ESB: High error rate ({ITEM.LASTVALUE}%)

item.name: WSO2 ESB: Total Fault Count (raw)
item.description: Cumulative total fault count extracted from the system statistics JSON. Used as a base for delta calculations.

item.name: WSO2 ESB: Fault Delta
item.description: Delta of the total fault counter between consecutive polls.

item.name: WSO2 ESB: Total Request Count (raw)
item.description: Cumulative total request count extracted from the system statistics JSON. Used as a base for delta calculations.

item.name: WSO2 ESB: Request Delta
item.description: Delta of the total request counter between consecutive polls.

item.name: WSO2 ESB: Total Response Count (raw)
item.description: Cumulative total response count extracted from the system statistics JSON. Used as a base for delta calculations.

item.name: WSO2 ESB: System Statistics JSON
item.description: Single JSON item containing all WSO2 system statistics. Includes serverName, totalFaultCount, totalRequestCount, totalResponseCount, avgResponseTime, minResponseTime, maxResponseTime, totalMemory, usedMemory, serverStartTime and systemUpTime. Acts as the master item for the per-counter dependent items.

trigger.name: WSO2 ESB: No data received from server (last 5 minutes)
trigger.description:
No data has been received from the WSO2 ESB server in the last 5 minutes.
Possible causes: - The WSO2 ESB server is stopped or unreachable - Network connectivity issues - Invalid SOAP credentials - StatisticsAdmin service is not responding
Checks: 1. Server status: {HOST.NAME} 2. Network connectivity to {$WSO2.HOST}:{$WSO2.PORT} 3. Zabbix server log for communication errors
Last value received: {ITEM.LASTVALUE}

item.name: WSO2 ESB: Time Delta
item.description: Seconds elapsed between consecutive polls. Used to normalize rate calculations.

discovery_rule.name: WSO2 ESB Service Discovery
discovery_rule.description: Low-level discovery for every WSO2 ESB service, driven by the JSON output of the master discovery item.

item_prototype.name: Service [{#SERVICE.NAME}]: Error Rate (%)
item_prototype.description: Per-service error rate: (faults / requests) * 100. Returns 0 when the underlying counters have no data.

trigger_prototype.name: Service [{#SERVICE.NAME}]: High error rate ({ITEM.LASTVALUE1}%)
trigger_prototype.description: Error rate for service {#SERVICE.NAME} exceeded {$WSO2.ERROR.RATE.THRESHOLD}%. Current value: {ITEM.LASTVALUE1}% Inspect service logs for details.

item_prototype.name: Service [{#SERVICE.NAME}]: Fault Delta
item_prototype.description: Per-poll fault delta for service {#SERVICE.NAME}. Identifies the source of new faults per polling interval.

trigger_prototype.expression: (last(/WSO2 ESB Service Monitoring/wso2.esb.service.stat.faults[{#SERVICE.NAME}],#1)<>last(/WSO2 ESB Service Monitoring/wso2.esb.service.stat.faults[{#SERVICE.NAME}],#2)) and last(/WSO2 ESB Service Monitoring/wso2.esb.service.stat.faults[{#SERVICE.NAME}])>0
trigger_prototype.name: Service [{#SERVICE.NAME}]: Fault count changed
trigger_prototype.description: Fault count for service {#SERVICE.NAME} has changed.

trigger_prototype.expression: last(/WSO2 ESB Service Monitoring/wso2.esb.service.stat.maxresponse[{#SERVICE.NAME}])>{$WSO2.MAX.RESPONSE.TIME} and last(/WSO2 ESB Service Monitoring/wso2.esb.service.stat.maxresponse[{#SERVICE.NAME}],#2)<{$WSO2.MAX.RESPONSE.TIME}
trigger_prototype.name: Service [{#SERVICE.NAME}]: Max response time exceeded ({ITEM.LASTVALUE1}s)
trigger_prototype.description:
Max response time for service {#SERVICE.NAME} crossed the {$WSO2.MAX.RESPONSE.TIME}s threshold.
Current value: {ITEM.LASTVALUE1}s Previous value: {ITEM.LASTVALUE2}s
Indicates a spike in response time.

item_prototype.name: Service [{#SERVICE.NAME}]: Statistics Raw XML
item_prototype.description: Master item. Raw SOAP XML response from getServiceStatistics. A single HTTP request feeds every per-service metric.

item_prototype.name: Service [{#SERVICE.NAME}]: WSDL Availability
item_prototype.description: WSDL reachability check for {#SERVICE.NAME}. 1 = available, 0 = unavailable.

trigger_prototype.name: Service [{#SERVICE.NAME}]: WSDL unavailable
trigger_prototype.description: WSDL for service {#SERVICE.NAME} is not reachable at {#WSDL.URL}.

trigger_prototype.expression: last(/WSO2 ESB Service Monitoring/wso2.esb.service.stat.maxresponse[{#SERVICE.NAME}])>{$WSO2.MAX.RESPONSE.TIME} and avg(/WSO2 ESB Service Monitoring/wso2.esb.service.stat.avgresponse[{#SERVICE.NAME}],15m)>avg(/WSO2 ESB Service Monitoring/wso2.esb.service.stat.avgresponse[{#SERVICE.NAME}],15m:now-15m)
trigger_prototype.recovery_expression: last(/WSO2 ESB Service Monitoring/wso2.esb.service.stat.maxresponse[{#SERVICE.NAME}])<={$WSO2.MAX.RESPONSE.TIME} or avg(/WSO2 ESB Service Monitoring/wso2.esb.service.stat.avgresponse[{#SERVICE.NAME}],10m)<=avg(/WSO2 ESB Service Monitoring/wso2.esb.service.stat.avgresponse[{#SERVICE.NAME}],10m:now-10m)
trigger_prototype.name: Service [{#SERVICE.NAME}]: Response time degradation (avg trending up)
trigger_prototype.description:
Service {#SERVICE.NAME} shows sustained performance degradation.
Max response time: {ITEM.LASTVALUE1}s (threshold: {$WSO2.MAX.RESPONSE.TIME}s) Average response time: rising over the last 15 minutes.
Investigate the cause of the persistent degradation.

macro.description: Maximum error rate (%) before the high-error-rate trigger fires.
Hostname or IP of the WSO2 ESB server.
Maximum allowed response time, in seconds (default: 2 minutes).
Port for the WSO2 ESB SOAP Admin API.
Password for SOAP API Basic authentication.
Username for SOAP API Basic authentication.
SSL certificate expiry CRITICAL threshold, in days.
SSL certificate expiry WARNING threshold, in days.
System-wide fault increase threshold over a 15-minute window (WARNING trigger).
Recovery threshold for the system fault increase trigger.
